item.title: Two Energies Choices

item.title: Matter and Karma
item.description: By Bhanu Swami Free Will: The individual can activate or deactivate his samskaras and vasanas by his choice of association and place. He can use his intelligence to control feeling (samskara and vasana) for attaining his chosen goal. Then he can act according to choice, not feeling. By intelligent acts he can alter his present and future karma. Purpose of Karma: Karma is not a punishment but a chance to recognize the responsibility we have for our acts. item.description: The contrast between simplicity/straightforwardness and crookedness.
